tool.name: french_company_search
tool.title: French Company Registry Search (SIRENE)
tool.description:
Search France's official company register (SIRENE/INSEE) by name, activity, department, or postal code, and export SIREN/SIRET identifiers, legal status, headquarters address, workforce, revenue, and officers.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/french-company-search'.
- Side Effects: Reads public sources and creates a billed Actor run and dataset on your Apify account.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 10-30 seconds; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for French corporate due diligence, company/officer lookups, industry (NAF) or regional market surveys, or B2B vendor verification in France.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for US environmental compliance, US campaign finance, clinical trials, or FDA drug/device data.
- Named alternatives: Use 'fec_campaign_finance_search' for US political funding, 'epa_facility_search' for environmental compliance, 'clinical_trials_search' for medical studies, or 'openfda_search' for FDA drug/device data.

query.description: Company name, trade name, or keyword to search for (e.g. 'boulangerie', 'Airbus').

department.description: French department code to filter by, e.g. '75' or '13'.

naf_code.description: French NAF/APE economic activity code to filter by, e.g. '62.01Z'.

active_only.description: Return only companies currently marked active. Defaults to true.

max_results.description: Maximum number of company records to retrieve. Defaults to 10.

siren.title: Siren
siren.description: Structured siren value returned by the French public company-data API backed by the SIRENE register.

name.title: Name
name.description: Organization, company, facility or record name as published by the source.

legal_name.title: Legal Name
legal_name.description: Structured legal name value returned by the French public company-data API backed by the SIRENE register.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current source-defined status of the organization, provider or study.

naf_code.title: Naf Code
naf_code.description: Structured naf code value returned by the French public company-data API backed by the SIRENE register.

hq_city.title: Hq City
hq_city.description: Structured hq city value returned by the French public company-data API backed by the SIRENE register.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Structured employees value returned by the French public company-data API backed by the SIRENE register.

revenue.title: Revenue (EUR)
revenue.description: Turnover for financials_year in whole euros, taken from the accounts filed with the commercial court. Only companies that file publicly have it.
